docket_entries.description: REQUEST TO APPEAR BY ZOOM FILED BY PLAINTIFF TIMES, DOMINIQUE

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JAN-26-2026 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JAN-26-2026 BY VISITING JUDGE FREDRICK. PLAINTIFF DOMINIQUE TIMES IS PRESENT VIA ZOOM. DEFENDANT ASHLEY KELLEM IS PRESENT IN COURT. DEFENDANT STATED SHE RECIEVED CERTIFIED MAIL SERVICE FROM THE COURT AND THEREFORE SERVICE IS WAIVED. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: JOSH M. FREDRICKS; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
